james_cust: Hey team — customer hitting intermittent 502/503 and an auth/billing error after token rotation. Example response shows 'billing: account_not_found'. We have a sample request id: 8d3a7f2b-cc4c-4a9a. Can we get minimal repro snippets (curl + py/js/go) + what logs/request headers to capture?

alice_support: Thanks James — can you confirm the affected endpoint (generate vs embeddings) and whether this is hosted or dedicated? Any recent token rotation events? :eyes:

james_cust: It's /v1/generate (text generation). Hosted. Customer said errors started after they rotated keys yesterday. No obvious deploys on our side.

alice_support: OK. Quick plan: 1) Ask customer to run a curl that surfaces response headers (X-Request-Id), full response body, and debug env var. 2) Provide tiny SDK repros (py/js/go) that mimic their payload. 3) Ask for SDK debug logs (env var) and a HAR if they can reproduce in browser. I'll drop minimal snippets below.

alice_support: Minimal curl to capture headers/body (have them redact tokens when pasting back):
```bash
curl -i -v \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-base-1","input":"hello"}' \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```
Notes: -i prints headers, -v shows connection info. Ask them to paste the full response headers (look for X-Request-Id or x-request-id).

alice_support: Quick Python (requests) repro — minimal, no retry logic:
```python
import os
import requests
API_KEY = os.environ.get('REDWOOD_API_KEY')
url = 'https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate'
resp = requests.post(url, json={'model':'rw-base-1','input':'hello'}, headers={'Authorization': f'Bearer {API_KEY}'})
print('status', resp.status_code)
print('headers:', resp.headers)
print('body:', resp.text)
```

alice_support: Node (fetch) minimal repro:
```js
const fetch = require('node-fetch')
const res = await fetch('https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'rw-base-1', input: 'hello' })
})
console.log('status', res.status)
console.log('headers', Object.fromEntries(res.headers.entries()))
console.log('body', await res.text())
```

alice_support: Go minimal repro (net/http):
```go
package main
import (
  "bytes"
  "fmt"
  "net/http"
  "os"
)
func main() {
  apiKey := os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY")
  body := []byte(`{"model":"rw-base-1","input":"hello"}`)
  req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", "https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate", bytes.NewBuffer(body))
  req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+apiKey)
  req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
  resp, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
  if err != nil { fmt.Println("err", err); return }
  defer resp.Body.Close()
  fmt.Println("status", resp.StatusCode)
  fmt.Println("headers", resp.Header)
}
```

mira_backend: Good snippets. Add these diagnostics to request: 1) full response headers (look for X-Request-Id), 2) capture request timestamp (local), 3) include the raw request body they sent. Also ask them to set the SDK debug env var so we can see HTTP retries and token usage. Suggest:
```
export REDWOOD_SDK_DEBUG=1
# or for short-lived test
REDWOOD_SDK_DEBUG=1 python repro.py
```

leo_sdk: FYI SDKs also emit a Request-ID header on the client when DEBUG=1; please ask them to capture logs and redact keys. If they can't reproduce, ask for a recording of the failing request time window (we can search logs by request id).

alice_support: For HAR collection (if the customer tried via browser): instruct them to open DevTools -> Network -> right-click -> Save all as HAR with content and include the failing request. If they used a server-side SDK, ask for the raw stdout/stderr from the repro run with REDWOOD_SDK_DEBUG=1.

nina_lead: Also request the billing account id they see in the error (don't ask for billing tokens). If the error body says 'account_not_found', copy the entire error JSON — that helps trace whether it's our auth service or the billing back-end.

james_cust: Passing this to customer now. I'll ask them to run curl + one of the SDK snippets and attach: 1) curl output (headers + body), 2) SDK debug log, 3) HAR (if applicable), 4) exact request id(s) they see. Will update here when they reply. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Scheduled maintenance: none in the window provided.

alice_support: Great — when they send the data, drop it here (redact tokens). If they provide a request-id I can jump to logs and share a timeline. If we see token rotation, we'll check key-store propagation delays.

james_cust: Customer returned: curl shows 503 with header 'X-Request-Id: 8d3a7f2b-cc4c-4a9a' and body: {"error":"billing: account_not_found"}. SDK log (attached) shows two attempts: first 200 then follow-up 503. Uploading logs now.

mira_backend: I'll take the request id and look in the ingestion logs for that window — please also include the local timestamps (UTC) when they ran the tests.

alice_support: Thanks. If you hit me with the request id + UTC timestamps I'll grep logs and reply with trace. If we need deeper data we'll request a debug bundle (we'll provide an S3 upload link).
